[Verifier 2026-10-05] Both ATM programme events set to amount_kind ceiling (programme maximums, not money received; the Jefferies programme was raised to $75M + $75M (Sep 2025) + $150M (Nov 2025) = $300M of capacity). The amounts actually sold, stated in the FY2025 10-K filed 2026-02-26, are now separate new_money events (net proceeds): Stifel FY2024 $21.4M, Stifel 2025 $36.4M, Jefferies 2025 $139.6M, Jefferies 2026-01-01 to 02-26 $10.9M. Stifel sales before 2024 (2019-2023) are not recorded (earlier 10-Ks not read). Public company (CIK 1084554). Per policy D8 only ATM programmes are recorded, not individual share sales. Amounts actually sold (from FY2025 10-K, snapshot 9d7cc820...): Stifel ATM net proceeds $21.4M in 2024 and $36.4M in 2025 (agreement terminated 2025-05-30); Jefferies ATM net proceeds $139.6M in 2025 (gross about $144.4M); total 2025 ATM net $176.0M; $142.1M remained available under the November 2025 prospectus supplement; Jan 1 to Feb 26 2026 net $10.9M. The Sep 2025 supplement added up to $75,000,000 and a Nov 2025 supplement (S-3ASR filed 2025-11-28) followed; these are all the Jefferies programme and not archived as separate events. Not covered: pre-2019 history (2010-2018 424B5 offerings listed in EDGAR submissions), DOE GAIN vouchers, any 2026 filings beyond Sept. The Battelle/INL agreements are cost-reimbursement arrangements where Lightbridge pays Battelle, recorded as agreements only, not funding. The Feb 2025 Series X preferred ($100) was a voting device, not funding.
